evidence: Check per quality-checks.md:71: '/app holds nothing but .gitkeep; no starter, skeleton, schema, route list, or partial UI anywhere in the agent image; nothing under /instructions/ reproduces criterion text or the rubric.' (1) Agent image: task/environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md. task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). It copies only instructions/ -> /instructions and assets/ -> /assets (lines 14-15), then creates /app with only .gitkeep committed (lines 17-23). solution/ and tests/ are outside the build context, and task.toml declares no prebuilt image. The global npm installs are express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1, which are dependencies, not deliverable code. (2) Seed asset: keys are generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10), jobs(3), applications(16), messages(127), notes(3), reads(6). These are raw inputs only, with no precomputed unread totals, seen flags, activity lines, expected outcomes, schema DDL, routes or UI. reads carry raw read_count inputs that rules.md section 9 says the app must interpret. generated_note only points to the rules file. The solution's src/seed_data.json is a byte-identical copy of the asset (sha a1c65c80...), so the golden consumes the input; the input does not contain the golden. (3) /instructions: hireops_rules.md is a behavioural spec of the product (the ask). It explicitly leaves 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages' to the builder (lines 3-5) and gives no code, schema, route list or skeleton. integration.md gives only runtime contract (entry, port, DB_PATH, health), which instruction.md:13 also states. (4) Rubric reproduction: a 10-token shingle scan of instruction.md + both notes against every tests/**/*.toml|*.md found exactly one overlap: 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order' in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:209. That phrase comes from public rules.md:90 ('They arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order'), and the criterion paraphrases the public rule. No criterion id, scenario detail (e.g. 'Y, W, X', 'A2, V'), weight or fail clause appears in /instructions. No other overlaps. Counterexample probes: a model cannot copy a finished app because none exists in /app, /assets or /instructions. A conforming alternative app is not disadvantaged by the environment, because it imposes no routes or ids. Runtime: no agent image was built or listed in this review (raw-evidence-index has only golden verifier-side artifacts; workspace.cjs and results/workspace.json hashes re-verified as 8c362561... and c73fa342...). The image contents are fully determined by the template-identical Dockerfile and the 3-file context, so static inspection settles this row. The frozen rules xlsx and the skill asset xlsx differ in hash, but row #16 text is identical; this is recorded for the owner and does not affect this verdict.
